units.source_text: 那年我二十岁，头戴高等学校的制帽，

en.t: That year I was twenty, wearing the cap of my higher school,

units.source_text: 身穿藏青碎白花纹上衣和裙裤，

en.t: dressed in a dark blue jacket with a small white pattern and in hakama trousers,
with a student satchel slung over my shoulder.

units.source_text: 我独自到伊豆旅行，已是第四天了。

en.t: It was already the fourth day of my solitary trip to Izu.

units.source_text: 在修善寺温泉歇了一宿，

en.t: I had spent one night at Shuzenji Hot Spring,
stayed two nights at Yugashima Hot Spring,

units.source_text: 然后蹬着高齿木屐爬上了天城山。

en.t: and then climbed Mount Amagi wearing high-toothed wooden clogs.

units.source_text: 重叠的山峦，原始的森林，深邃的幽谷，一派秋色，

en.t: Layer upon layer of mountains, primeval forests, and deep secluded valleys were all steeped in autumn colors,
a sight so rich that the eye could hardly take it all in.

units.source_text: 可是，我的心房却在猛烈跳动。

en.t: Yet my heart was pounding violently.

units.source_text: 因为一个希望在催促我赶路。

en.t: For a certain hope was urging me onward.

units.source_text: 这时候，大粒的雨点开始敲打着我。

en.t: Just then, large raindrops began striking me.

units.source_text: 我跑步登上曲折而陡峭的山坡，

en.t: I hurried up the winding, steep mountain slope, almost at a run,

units.source_text: 好不容易爬到了天城岭，来到了北口的一家茶馆前，

en.t: and at last reached Amagi Pass and came to a teahouse at the northern entrance,

units.source_text: 吁了一口气，呆若木鸡地站在那里。

en.t: where I let out a breath and stood there in a daze.

units.source_text: 我完全如愿以偿了，因为巡回艺人一行正在那里小憩。

en.t: My wish had been completely fulfilled, for the troupe of traveling performers was resting there.
